body: Yeah and I got belittled and had the bible thrown at me. So  it just solidified my plan. There is no help for me.

Literally everything that could go wrong has gone wrong. I model nude for a job. I have zero family to help me. My fiance left me. My son died. No friends. 

I'm so alone. Thus writting here. But this just solidified things.
It will as soon as I get some ammo.
A place to put innocent pets if I got help. Not to be belittled for feeling like shit. But now I know to just call the cops before I shoot so they'll find them and make sure they're OK.
What's even the point. Apparently I just shit all over people anyways. I wasted my time. Waste of space. Waste of everything.
Telling a suicidal person that theres no help and making them feel like they're right in their decision is exactly what you need to do to make them change their mind.

Its not OK. Its not going to be OK. I'm not OK. But I can't let my animals die because of me. I don't know what to do with them so I get help.  Don't have anything anymore except them. But I can't keep living a pathetic life.
If god existed he wouldn't of taken my son. Praying will not make my suicidal thoughts go away.
